nina: Follow-up from today's postmortem — we've observed recurring KV residency regressions driving OOM recoveries across a few shards. Pasting a short action plan + owners so things don't fall through the cracks.

ops-bot: ALERT kv_residency_regression affected=shard-3,shard-9 time=2026-04-12T08:22:15Z failures=64 restarts=2 link=https://ops/reports/3260012345

devon: I pulled a short resident trace before the restart and uploaded alloc pprof. Pattern looks like: partial GC -> burst of many small allocations -> resident nudges past soft cap -> eviction stalls. Snippet: `kv/residency.go:310 softcap=5.2G resident=5.9G`. Repro hint: run high-concurrency get workload with heavy prefix churn.

sam: Short-term mitigation proposal (canary-first): reduce soft cap a notch, bump eviction hysteresis, and enable continuous small-object sampling. Example env to roll: `KV_SOFT_CAP=5.0G, KV_EVICT_HYST=0.2, SMALL_ALLOC_SAMPLER=1, PPROF_INTERVAL=10m`. This should lower pressure and give us artifacts to analyze.

marco: I'll schedule a canary rollout this afternoon and run a 24h smoke. I'll add p95/p99 token-latency, eviction-rate, and resident to the canary dashboard and alert on >10% p95 regression or eviction-rate >0.5/s/shard.

nina: Owners & timeline: devon = reproduce + pre/mid/post heap dumps (due EOD), sam = mitigation + slab-bucket experiment plan (by next sprint), marco = canary rollout + 24h smoke (start today), lia = add regression eval for allocation-rate-per-request to CI. Weekly syncs x3.

lia: Note: lowering caps can increase evictions that hurt long-sequence tail latency. Keep an eye on large-seq request p95 and abort if necessary.

qa-bot: QA checklist added to ticket KV-900: [ ] repro verified on canary, [ ] heaps uploaded, [ ] mitigation rolled, [ ] 24h smoke green, [ ] retro actions added to tracker.

sam: Creating follow-ups: KV-900 repro/heaps (devon) due +7d; KV-901 slab rebucket experiment (sam) due +14d; KV-902 canary & dashboards (marco) due +3d.

ops-bot: Tickets created KV-900, KV-901, KV-902. Assignees/devs set. Auto-due +7d/+14d/+3d.

devon: I'll start capturing flamegraphs on canary and post links here once available.

marco: Pushed canary flags, profiler on, starting smoke now. Will post the first pprof upload in ~30m. :thumbsup:
